title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
description:
Design an algorithm to **serialize** a binary tree into a string and **deserialize** that string back into the original tree.

Implement both functions. The test calls `deserialize(serialize(root))` and expects a tree identical to the original (same shape, same values). You may choose any string format you like; your serialized value must be a string, and it must not rely on state shared between the two calls.
hints: A preorder walk that also records where children are missing (for example with a "#" marker) is enough to rebuild the tree.
When deserializing, consume the tokens in the same order using a shared index or queue.
